node.title: Re^3: This site is not secure continues
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: See also [Corion]'s post [id://1217614|here], this means that currently perlmonks.com should always work, and hopefully they'll get it straightened out so that perlmonks.org and perlmonks.net also work. I'm not sure what'll happen to perlmonks.pairsite.com - at the moment it seems to be having DNS issues.
